zones.title: Find slots
zones.body: DealerBook availability for the agreed dealer from the requested date.

zones.title: Remember what was offered
zones.body: Offered slots are stored on the session so a booking can only name one of them.

panels.title: AR-12 FindSlots
panels.body: The offered slots are written to the session row. BookAppointment refuses any slotId that was not offered in this call: slots are facts, not model output.
